_meta.source: Drive: work/neural-forward-emg/pd-lab-mris-macbook-version/{AG,DH,Kostia}/Labels.txt — ITK-SnAP Label Description files, ground truth as named by the pd-lab annotator.
_meta.supersedes: template01_label_to_muscle.json (kept for backwards compat but its names labels 2-19 are WRONG — based on autoseg-17 convention which doesn't apply to PD_PROPELLER).
_meta.convention: ITK-SnAP integer labels with anatomical names. Labels 2,3 are BONES. Labels 15/25/26/27 are FAT. Label 1 is fiducial Markers. The rest are muscles.

subjects.DH: PD_PROPELLER_5MM_FATS_FLX_0012 (= our PD_PROPELLER template01 — confirmed by MD5 + label-permutation analysis in mri/)
subjects.Kostia: PD_PROPELLER_5MM_FATS_0004 (includes label 24 = Brachial m. which DH/AG don't)

_meta.neurodec_discrepancy: Neurodec's forward-model-deliverable lists ECRB and ECRL as SEPARATE muscles, but pd-lab Labels.txt combines them into a single label 12 = 'ExtensorCarpiRadialisLongus+Brevis'. Either Neurodec used a different (finer) segmentation than what's in pd-lab-mris-macbook-version, OR their ECRB/ECRL split was done downstream from label 12 by manual / morphological splitting.

12.name: ExtensorCarpiRadialisLongus+Brevis
12.note: Combined; NOT separated in pd-lab segmentation

24.name: Brachial
24.note: Only present in Kostia — proximal-only muscle that exits the FOV in DH/AG

atlas_keys._comment: Lieber atlas keys for the muscles that have a 1-to-1 atlas analogue. Use this for pennation / fascicle-length lookup in mri/data/forearm_muscle_atlas.json. Combined-label 12 maps to the LONGUS variant by default (the larger of the two); split downstream if needed.
